items.text: Indianapolis QB: Colts waived Daniel Jones Nov 20; Anthony Richardson Sr. named starter vs NYG (schedule listing correct).

Indianapolis (early week): RB Seth McGowan (hamstring) will miss time. Out Wk11, no update yet - OT Jalen Travis (knee), OT Bernhard Raimann, CB Charvarius Ward (knee), DT Jerry Tillery (calf), TE Will Mallory. IR - WR Alec Pierce, LB Jaylon Carlies, LB Akeem Davis-Gaither, TE Mo Alie-Cox, CB Cam Taylor-Britt.
NY Giants (early week): CB Greg Newsome II (high ankle sprain) out multiple weeks; LB Kayvon Thibodeaux returned after a knock. J.J. McCarthy starts.

adjust.reason: Indianapolis missed both starting tackles, CB Charvarius Ward and DT Tillery last week with WR Pierce and two LBs on IR, against the Giants' main loss of CB Newsome. The stats model doesn't price non-QB injuries
